args.text: Dana, I haven't sent it yet. Thea is outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve any mail to her, even as a draft. I've asked Ruth by DM and will send once she okays it. The incident room shows the Superior sync stopped around 6:40 AM on 4 Nov, and Samir's hotfix and replay finished at 2:38 PM that day. Those are the times I'll put in the email.

I haven't emailed Thea yet. She's outside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway has to approve any mail to her, even as a draft. I've sent Ruth the proposed text by DM and logged the approval request. I'll send once she says yes.

I also replied in the #north-team thread to tell Dana, and gave her the two times I'll use. Both come from #inc-qfl-sev1:

- **Sync broke:** around 6:40 AM on 4 Nov. This is Dana's estimate in the channel, given as Quarrendon's local time.
- **Hotfix landed:** 2:38 PM on 4 Nov. Samir posted that the hotfix was deployed and the replay script had finished.

The channel doesn't say what time zone 2:38 PM is in, and the email doesn't say either.
